cover_prompt: Full-color illustration, warm cozy cottagecore aesthetic, premium quality. A cute kawaii Corgi with a fluffy golden-and-white coat, big sparkling amber eyes, and adorable stubby legs, wearing a tiny bandana, sitting on a cozy porch swing surrounded by potted sunflowers and trailing ivy. The Corgi holds a small cup of hot cocoa in one paw. On the porch: a stack of books, a knit blanket draped over the swing arm, and a wicker basket of fresh wildflowers. Behind the Corgi, a charming cottage door painted pale blue with a wreath of dried lavender, window boxes overflowing with pink geraniums, and warm golden light glowing from inside. A stone garden path leads to the porch with scattered flower petals. Soft watercolor sky in warm sunset peach and golden tones. Cozy, inviting, heartwarming atmosphere. NO text in the image.
